text: ポケモンリーグ　いきまくりだねー　じゃ　コレ　あげるよー

structure.jp: ポケモンリーグ　いきまくりだねー
structure.en: you've been going to the Pokémon League like crazy

structure.jp: じゃ　コレ　あげるよー
structure.en: well then, I'll give you this

patterns.name: 〜まくる
patterns.explanation: まくる stuck onto a verb says it is done again and again without holding back; まくり is its thing-like form used with だ. いきまくり = 'going like crazy'.
